Maya (Marketing): Hey runtime team — quick scoped ask for launch bench artifacts. Need tidy numbers and reproducible steps for one blog slide + webinar demo.

Maya (Marketing): What we need: (A) coldstart p50/p95/p99 for stable-13b-v1 quantized-8 and fp16, (B) steady-state at 2 RPS and 40 RPS, (C) 5 raw traces per config, (D) README with exact commands, seed, and warmup policy. Deadline: 48h.

Raj (Eng - Runtime): We can run this. Confirm region (us-west-2 hosted) and seed (2024)? Also note: quant pool may queue.

Maya (Marketing): Yes us-west-2 hosted, seed=2024. Coldstart = fresh container, no primes. For steady-state, prime with 10 requests.

Sofia (Eng - Runtime): Plan: 50 cold samples per variant, 5min steady for each RPS level, collect token breakdown and cost estimates. We'll upload zip with CSV, traces, and README.

duty-bot: duty-bot: bench job #6123 started (quantized-8 us-west-2).

Raj (Eng - Runtime): ETA Tue 12:00 PT. We'll flag any nondet outliers in-thread.

Maya (Marketing): Great — include one-line suggested blurb for the slide about tail variance so comms can edit.
